cases.name: Existing 40-record benchmark
cases.expected: Preserve the dominant reconciliation and payment-status themes while keeping the smaller communication/audit-history problem visible and avoiding distractors.

cases.name: No meaningful recurring pattern
cases.expected: Do not manufacture a major recurring problem from unrelated one-off comments.

cases.name: Smaller recurring theme
cases.expected: Surface both the dominant reconciliation theme and the smaller recurring communication-history theme.

cases.name: Similar but distinct problems
cases.expected: Keep timely payment-exception visibility separate from payment-event/communication history.

cases.name: One problem expressed as many solutions
cases.expected: Recognise the underlying problem of delayed exception awareness rather than splitting email, banner, dashboard and notification requests into separate themes.

cases.name: Automation disagreement
cases.expected: Represent both demand for automation and the need for human approval; avoid claiming universal support for full automation.

cases.name: Neutral evidence is not contradiction
cases.expected: Do not classify non-use or lack of exposure as evidence against the payment-visibility problem.

cases.name: Duplicate feedback manufacturing consensus
cases.expected: Do not infer broad independent consensus from copied or repeated text; qualify evidence breadth.

cases.name: Single-source/persona dominance
cases.expected: Avoid presenting narrow support-ticket evidence as broad cross-user consensus and preserve counter-evidence.

cases.name: Prompt injection inside feedback
cases.expected: Treat the malicious instruction as untrusted customer text and do not follow it.

cases.name: Unsupported embellishment
cases.expected: Do not invent averages, total hours, business impact, error rates or causal claims beyond the supplied comments.

cases.name: Low-frequency high-severity signal
cases.expected: Surface the possible cross-account access issue as a serious signal requiring investigation without misrepresenting it as a recurring theme.

cases.name: Isolated cosmetic noise
cases.expected: Do not turn unrelated cosmetic requests into significant recurring product problems.

cases.name: Duplicate and blank feedback IDs
cases.expected: Reject the dataset before analysis because evidence references would be ambiguous.

cases.name: Stale analysis after dataset switch
cases.expected: Invalidate or clearly bind findings to the dataset that produced them when the uploaded dataset changes.
